title: news home publish
description: Publish an approved curation: PUT /v1/home/curation with `Idempotency-Key: home-curation:<draft>:<sha256 of the body>`, which validates again, writes the next version, moves LATEST and purges the home page and region views. G tier: Chief runs it in process as the authorised step of a live run (the `publish` approval); this CLI form always answers `gated`. Checks run again first; the approval time and results are fixed once, so a rerun after a crash sends the same bytes under the same key and the API answers with the version it already committed. Input is the command's arguments as an object; output is the envelope's data.

already_published.description: Present and true when the draft was already live; nothing was sent.
